map.输入目标完赛时间或目标配速，自动计算配速、速度与分段用时: Enter a target finish time or target pace to automatically compute pace, speed, and split times
map.📖 查看「马拉松配速计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Marathon Pace Calculator user guide"
map.💡 配速 = 总用时 ÷ 距离；速度 = 距离 ÷ 用时(h)。负分段指后半程比: 💡 Pace = total time ÷ distance; speed = distance ÷ time (h). A negative split means the second half is faster than the first.
map.⚠️ 爬升修正为经验估算（每米爬升约 +0.012%），实际受地形、体能影响较大: ⚠️ Elevation correction is an empirical estimate (about +0.012% per meter climbed); actual impact varies greatly with terrain and fitness.
map.常见配速参考：5:00/km 全马约 3:30，6:00/km 全马约 4:13: Common pace reference: 5:00/km is about a 3:30 marathon; 6:00/km is about 4:13
map.负分段建议业余跑者 2%–4%，精英选手可达 5%+: A negative split of 2-4% is recommended for amateur runners; elites can reach 5%+
map.由目标完赛时间算每公里配速。: Compute per-kilometer pace from a target finish time.
map.按目标完赛时间反推每公里配速，分解到各分段控速防前快后崩。: Work back from the target finish time to per-kilometer pace, then break it into splits to control speed and avoid going out too fast and blowing up.
map.后半程略快于前半，利于匀速完赛。: The second half slightly faster than the first, which favors an even overall finish.
map.负分割配速策略是什么？: What is the negative-split pacing strategy?
map.后半程略快于前半（负分割）常成绩更好，但需建立在足够耐力基础之上。: A slightly faster second half (negative split) often yields a better result, but it must be built on sufficient endurance.
